display.purpose: The wall's lead game name, fitted to its column; one per screen, drafted between dimension lines.

headline.purpose: A game page's name, Ignition's title, the profile name.

figure.purpose: Big numbers: Ignition percent, free-machine count, come-back timer; latency at 38px in machine rows.

wordmark.purpose: The bar's wordmark (still reads Swiff pending the rename).

lead.purpose: The one spoken line under a name.

item.purpose: Game card titles; machine names at 600 18px; reading values at 500 19px.

control.purpose: Uppercase nav items, band tabs, tier names.

label.purpose: Mono readings and annotations, placed under what they describe.

components.css: .ds-ledger { display: grid; gap: 8px; width: 320px; } .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 86px minmax(0,1fr); align-items: center; gap: 0 14px; padding: 14px 16px 14px 14px; border: 1px solid rgb(19 19 19 / .34); border-radius: 14px; background: #f4f4f2; color: #131313; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; font: 300 16px/1.5 Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), border-color .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-row:not(.ds-on):hover { border-color: #131313; background: #fff; } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #131313; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-row.ds-on { background: #131313; border-color: #131313; color: #e8e9e8; } .ds-ms { font: 400 38px/1 Michroma, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ms small { margin-left: 4px; font: 400 13px/1 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; opacity: .7; } .ds-row b { display: block; font: 600 18px/1.2 Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-who { display: block; font-size: 13.5px; color: #4a4b4b; } .ds-on .ds-who, .ds-on .ds-meta { color: rgb(232 233 232 / .78); } .ds-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; margin-top: 7px; color: #4a4b4b; font: 400 11px/1.6 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-meta i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #d4f53c; }

components.name: The Screen
components.description: The one dark object: 16:9, 16px radius, 6px bezel, cast shadow and stand; off, a breathing dashed lime frame.
components.css: .ds-screen-wrap { display: grid; justify-items: center; padding: 24px; background: #e8e9e8; } .ds-screen { width: 420px; aspect-ratio: 16/9; border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgb(244 244 242 / .9) 30%, rgb(244 244 242 / .9) 70%, transparent) center / 100% 2px no-repeat, radial-gradient(120% 90% at 30% 0%, #1d1e1d, #131313 70%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px #131313, 0 24px 44px -24px rgb(19 19 19 / .55); outline: 1.5px dashed #d4f53c; outline-offset: -12px; animation: ds-breathe 2.8s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-stand { width: 132px; height: 22px; margin-top: 8px; background: linear-gradient(#131313, #131313) center 0 / 30px 17px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#131313, #131313) center bottom / 100% 5px no-repeat; border-radius: 0 0 5px 5px; } @keyframes ds-breathe { 0%, 100% { outline-color: rgb(212 245 60 / .4); } 50% { outline-color: #d4f53c; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-screen { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The app is a drafting-table room in daylight: grey-white paper under a fine static grain, panels laid on it as cards with hairline edges, and one dark television, the screen, where the game's key art lives. The art is never the page. It sits on a 16:9 screen with a rounded bezel and a stand, and the lit screen casts a warm spill of light onto the paper beneath it. Everything else is ink on paper: titles drafted in wide uppercase between dimension lines with end ticks, machine readings set in small mono like annotations on a technical drawing, and rulers of ticks along the bottom of bands and pickers.

The density is calm and instrument-like. A screen holds one name, one screen, one strip of facts and one action. Actions are pills and circles, never boxes: the main press is a filled ink pill or a circular dial (Resume, the hold-to-launch Reticle) drawn with tick rings and corner brackets. Lime is not a colour of the interface; it is a mark, a small signal that something is live, chosen, or done.

Motion is slow, eased, and physical: the screen's dashed lime frame breathes while it waits, Ignition opens the picture from one bright line to the full frame as the connection comes up, a freed machine rings its card once in lime. Under reduced motion nothing moves on its own.
keyCharacteristics: Paper ground, card panels on 1px hairlines, ink type; no dark pages.
Key art only on the screen: a dark rounded 16:9 with a 6px bezel, a stand, and a warm light spill.
Michroma uppercase titles drafted between dimension lines; Outfit for reading; IBM Plex Mono for readings and annotations.
Lime used only as a mark: live dots, the current tab's bar, done ticks, the waiting screen's dashed frame.
Everything you press is a pill or a circle.

rules.name: The Mark Rule
rules.body: Lime is a mark, never a fill, a surface, or text on paper. If a lime element is wider than 18px it is a frame line or a ring, not an area.

rules.name: The One Screen Rule
rules.body: The only dark surface on a renter page is the screen (and the chosen machine card that borrows its colour). Key art is painted on the screen and nowhere else; no art bands behind copy, no full-bleed dark pages.

rules.name: The Drafted Name Rule
rules.body: Every screen's name is Michroma uppercase between a cap line and a base line of `line-2`, each with 9px end ticks, running 14px past the word on both sides.

rules.name: The Annotation Rule
rules.body: A mono label sits under the name or value it describes, as a drawing's annotation, never above it as an eyebrow. The build enforces this by reordering every label below its title.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: Only the screen casts a shadow. A card that needs to stand out gets an ink border or the screen's colour, not a shadow.

dos: Do set every renter screen on paper (#e8e9e8), with card-stock panels bordered by 1px `line-2` hairlines at 14px or 22px radius.
Do put a game's key art on the screen: 16:9, 16px radius, 6px bezel, stand, and the warm spill once lit.
Do draft each screen's name in Michroma uppercase between dimension lines with 9px end ticks.
Do set readings and annotations in IBM Plex Mono 11.5px uppercase, placed under the thing they describe.
Do make every pressable thing a pill or a circle, with the primary in filled ink.
Do use `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` for state changes (0.3s colour, 0.35s pills, 0.45s to 0.5s turns) and gate any self-running motion behind `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`.
Do give lime on paper a 1px `lime-edge` or `lime-deep` inset so the mark holds against the grey.
donts: Don't paint key art full-bleed behind copy or as a dark page band; the Share page's art band is hidden in the build for this reason.
Don't use lime as a fill, a surface, or text on paper.
Don't add drop shadows to cards, pills or panels; only the screen casts one.
Don't set a mono label above a title as an eyebrow.
Don't bring the library's dark glass or gradient buttons onto renter screens; they are re-pointed to ink and paper here, and the dark look belongs to the in-session HUD only.
Don't set text lighter than `ink-3` (#636464) on paper.
